## Adding a language layout? (delete this section otherwise)

- [ ] File is `Layouts/<id>.json` and `id` matches the file name
- [ ] Copied from `Layouts/TEMPLATE.json`; `name`, `language`, `authors`, `physicalLayout` filled in
- [ ] `macInputSources` lists the macOS input source id(s) for this layout
- [ ] Legends describe what macOS types with that input source (base and Shift)
- [ ] `swift test` passes locally (the `testCommunityLayouts` check)
- [ ] Screenshot of the Layouts page showing the language (optional, but very helpful)

## Changing code or the protocol? (delete this section otherwise)

- [ ] Tested on a real keyboard: model, layout, firmware: …
- [ ] Bytes sent and received are in the description, and a unit test covers them
- [ ] No vendor code, images or firmware added
